value.rationale: The physically relevant model requires unit-interval invariance. The theorem determines exactly where its upper positive steady state loses local stability within that biologically permissible parameter budget, quantifies a sharp all-shape change in that fraction, and proves a genuine flip always precedes loss of admissibility. This is a natural structural comparison across the motivating model family rather than an arbitrary finite computation; no separate major theorem about global chaos is claimed.
